translations.name: Veteran Readiness and Employment (VR&E)
translations.description: Veteran Readiness and Employment, also called Chapter 31 or VR&E, is a VA program for service members and Veterans whose service-connected disability limits their ability to work. It can help you learn new skills, find a job, go back to your old job, start a business, or live more independently. Apply online with VA Form 28-1900. VA decides if you qualify.
translations.website_description: Job training and employment help for Veterans with a service-connected disability.
